headword: {継続|けいぞく}は{力|ちから}なり
reading: けいぞくはちからなり
gloss: persistence pays off; continuity is strength

definitions.gloss: persistence pays off; continuity is strength; perseverance is power
definitions.explanation: A proverb meaning that continuing steadily at something, even in small amounts, will eventually lead to great results. Equivalent to "practice makes perfect" or "slow and steady wins the race."

examples.japanese: {継続|けいぞく}は{力|ちから}なり⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: They say persistence pays off, after all.

examples.japanese: {継続|けいぞく}は{力|ちから}なり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{信|しん}じて→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}している→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧。
examples.english: Believing that persistence pays off, I study a little bit every day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{三年間|さんねんかん}→三年間：28861_sannenkan⟧⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧⟦ジョギング→ジョギング：04738_jogingu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て、フルマラソン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{完走|かんそう}→完走：16981_kansou⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。{継続|けいぞく}は{力|ちから}なりだ。
examples.english: I kept jogging every morning for three years and was able to finish a full marathon. Persistence really is power.

notes:
One of the most well-known Japanese proverbs. ⟦なり→なり：09883_nari⟧ is a classical copula (equivalent to modern ⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧), giving the expression a timeless, proverbial tone. Literally: "continuation is strength."

USAGE:
Widely used as encouragement or as a motto. Very popular in educational settings, sports, and self-improvement contexts. Often quoted as a standalone phrase or with ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ (they say). Also commonly seen as calligraphy or on motivational posters.
